notes.title: Minor updates with some nice improvements
notes.content:
Happy Friday,
We are releasing a new update with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] VR POV now uses a head title so your head is by default tilted to the action making for a much nicer experience and easier on your neck ;)
[*] VR hands used to collide with the model and show up at your face which was really annoying. We've fixed that in this build 
[*] Improvements to some visual issues in the stories
[/list]

notes.title: New SEX Positions and more
notes.content:
Yes, it's time for an update.
And this time we have some new positions for you at Spooky Park.
But that's not all, we've also improved the following:
[list]
[*] Better UX / UI for VR users. It is much more simplified and easier to use.
[*] Improved skin shader that looks much smoother and more realistic
[*] Better head and eye movement
[*] Many fixes to interpenetration and other animation issues
[/list]

Hope you find this update well and we are looking to add more features in the next few months.
Enjoy.

notes.title: 📣 Announcement: Bambie! - Embrace the Plastic Magic! 🩰🎮
notes.content:
Calling all gamers and fans of enchanting adventures! Prepare to enter a world of whimsy and delight with "Bambie!". Get ready to embark on a captivating journey filled with charm, hornyness, and plastic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38926637/6620b0c468cd7be585c9d6a9879eadac46e329b9.jpg[/img]

Meet Barbara, our delightful protagonist, and her fabulous friends: Chelsea, the caring dentist; Marge, the brilliant doctor; Nina, the agile gymnast; and Stacey, the charismatic bartender. These unique characters will charm you with their personalities and skills.

But the adventure doesn't end there! Encounter Ryan and Kent, two charming guys who will add more excitement to your journey.

Explore four enchanting scenes filled with magic and wonder. Immerse yourself in a world where dreams come true and fantasies become reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38926637/8c79d498e1f6380a5c14aa62d4da7bfdfcc0df7e.gif[/img]
      
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484790/Bambie/][h1]Whishlist now [u]here[/u]![/h1][/url][/b]

[h3]🗓️ Save the date! "Bambie!" releases next Friday, on the 21st, bringing pink-tastic enchantment and to the gaming world.[/h3]
